parameters.jsCode:
const d = $input.first().json;

const filesSummary = (d.files || [])
  .filter(f => !f.binary && f.content && f.content !== '[binary file]')
  .map(f => `FILE: ${f.filename}\n${(f.content || '').slice(0, 800)}`)
  .join('\n\n---\n\n');

const prompt = `You are a LinkedIn content writer for a software developer. Generate a structured LinkedIn post and GitHub metadata.

PROJECT DETAILS:
- Name: ${d.project_name}
- Framework: ${d.detection?.framework || 'Python'}
- Type: ${d.detection?.type || 'python_project'}
- AI Summary: ${d.gemini_analysis?.summary || ''}
- Tech Stack: ${JSON.stringify(d.gemini_analysis?.tech_stack || [])}
- Tone: ${d.linkedin_tone || 'Professional'}

PROJECT FILE CONTENTS (read carefully to understand what this project actually does):
${filesSummary}

README EXCERPT:
${(d.readme_content || '').slice(0, 600)}

---

TASK 1 — repo_description:
Write max 350 characters. Factual. No hype. Describe what it does technically.

TASK 2 — topics:
Array of 8-10 lowercase GitHub topic strings. Example: ["python", "streamlit", "automation"]

TASK 3 — linkedin_post:
Write EXACTLY this structure. Do NOT deviate. Do NOT write a short caption.

[HOOK LINE]
One powerful line. No emoji. Must mention the problem solved and what was built.
Example: "I was spending 3 hours releasing every project manually. So I automated the entire thing."

[BLANK LINE]

Here is what it does:
🔍 [Feature 1 from actual code] — [short description]
📄 [Feature 2 from actual code] — [short description]
🐙 [Feature 3 from actual code] — [short description]
📸 [Feature 4 from actual code] — [short description]
✍️ [Feature 5 from actual code] — [short description]
✅ [Feature 6 from actual code] — [short description]

[BLANK LINE]

Built with: [tech1] — [tech2] — [tech3] — [list all from tech stack]

[BLANK LINE]

[One powerful insight or lesson from building this. Make it memorable.]
[One final punchy line. Make people want to build something.]

[BLANK LINE]

#[hashtag1] #[hashtag2] #[hashtag3] [12-15 total hashtags, mix of tech + career + domain]

STRICT RULES:
- linkedin_post MUST have all 4 sections above
- MUST have exactly 6 emoji features
- Features MUST come from actual file contents above — not invented
- Hook line MUST NOT start with "I just built and published"
- Total words in linkedin_post: 160-220 words (excluding hashtags)
- Return ONLY valid JSON. No markdown. No explanation.

RETURN FORMAT:
{"repo_description": "...", "topics": ["..."], "linkedin_post": "..."}`;

return {
  ...d,
  metadata_prompt: prompt
};
